Class SysTest

@IsTest()
private class SysTest

Unit tests for Sys utility class. Validates debug logging functionality including standard and JSON output methods with and without trace information, exception formatting, asynchronous Flow interview enqueuing via enqueueFlow(), and standard pricebook retrieval via getStandardPricebookId().
